players.product: Indium phosphide (InP) wafers (2-4 inch) for optical-communication lasers and detectors, made by subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials; also gallium arsenide wafers and germanium products (germanium ingots, germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, solar germanium wafers, infrared optics)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 sales volume and revenue of PV-grade germanium products fell year on year (as did fiber-grade): because of upstream raw-material price fluctuations the company changed their pricing to pass through cost, and new-order negotiations with downstream customers lengthened.
